trailhead.label: The car park by the Rienz stadium in Bruneck, where the Sternwaldile lane starts the nature trail

cautions: The Rienz runs fast beside the track: keep your dog out of the river.
Cyclists share the track on path 14.
A barbecue area by the stadium at the start.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.The car park by the Rienz stadium in Bru: Il parcheggio vicino allo stadio della Rienza a Brunico, dove la stradina Sternwaldile dà inizio al sentiero natura
textIt.The Rienz runs fast beside the track: ke: La Rienza scorre veloce accanto alla strada: tieni il cane fuori dal fiume.
Sul sentiero 14 la strada è condivisa con i ciclisti.
textIt.A barbecue area by the stadium at the st: Un’area barbecue vicino allo stadio alla partenza.
